linux_run.target: Linux AMD64, ReXGlue runtime with shift-native Vulkan plugin

synthetic_renderer_control.runtime_log_confirmation: shift-native: submitted 1 captured indexed draw packets to the Vulkan presenter at 1280x720; saved Vulkan guest output 1280x720; non-black pixels 518400; FNV-1a DA74DA070BC0D725
synthetic_renderer_control.interpretation: The diagnostic replaces the fragment shader output and confirms raster/presenter/readback coverage only. It is synthetic and is not retail pixel output.

test_environment_cleanup.before: 13 unused ReXGlue xenia_memory_* POSIX shared-memory objects occupied 4.7 GiB of the 5.9 GiB /dev/shm mount.
test_environment_cleanup.action: Each object was confirmed unreferenced with fuser and owned by the current user before unlinking.
test_environment_cleanup.after: A fresh retail black readback and magenta diagnostic both succeeded; /dev/shm had 5.8 GiB available.
test_environment_cleanup.interpretation: The SIGBUS/readback-write failures observed before cleanup were caused during runs with stale shared-memory allocations and are not treated as retail guest semantics evidence.

descriptor_head_watch.late_install_run: The worker breakpoint saw descriptor head 3 after the first source-0 callback had already seen head 1; no later descriptor+0 watch hit was recorded.
descriptor_head_watch.early_install_run: The watch was installed at the first source-0 callback with head 1; no subsequent descriptor+0 changes were recorded during the 65-second bounded run.
descriptor_head_watch.limitation: The watched descriptor word is not established as the EVENT_WRITE_SHD destination. These observations do not prove that EVENT_WRITE_SHD did or did not update a different guest address.

event_write_log.limitation: The retained Linux runtime log has no per-packet destination/value line; exact Linux guest write target remains unverified.

runtime_output.interpretation: These are execution and submission observations only. The readback has zero non-black RGB pixels and does not show visible retail content.

filesystem_observation.interpretation: A packed archive with a related name exists, but its member table was not verified here. The failed loose-file probes may be fallback searches and are not yet established as a fatal VFS defect.

blockers: The main menu and offline race have not been verified.
The exact EVENT_WRITE_SHD guest destination/value is not present in the retained Linux runtime log.
